build.provenance: Production build after reconciling the Admin branch with main PR103 optional SuitFire branding. Asset hashes identify the measured compiled build.

method.fixture: e2e/admin-server.js with fresh isolated local data
method.build: Production webpack build with loopback API origin
method.samples: Three fresh browser contexts at host speed, followed by one Chromium 4x CPU sample
method.cache: Fresh storage; external-origin route guard disables HTTP cache
method.network: Loopback without network throttling; static server sends uncompressed assets with Cache-Control: no-store
method.home: Navigation to /admin/gauntlet?area=Home through visible Home heading and two animation frames
method.content: Content navigation through visible target catalog record and two animation frames
method.record: Record click through visible Draft name input and two animation frames
method.typing: Three real keyboard characters; event-to-two-animation-frame delay, not field INP; local buffer restored without saving
method.isolation: All non-loopback HTTP(S) browser origins blocked. No production mutations or profile payloads recorded.
method.contention: The reconciled-build samples ran without other agent-owned builds or tests.
method.brand: Default Gauntlet Online; fresh context with no saved preview preference and an isolated synthetic account not eligible for the optional brand.

comparison.change: Request the catalog on first Content or Players use, retaining it for the operator session and preserving explicit refresh.
comparison.interpretation: The request is absent from Home in all final samples. The baseline predates both catalog deferral and main PR103 reconciliation. Local timing variability does not establish a before/after speedup; the verified improvement is deferring this large unused startup response.

requestProof.note: These include existing application and engine dependencies, not only the Admin-source budget. Gzip equivalents use exact requested build files; local transfer was uncompressed.
requestProof.sharedContentChunks: content-consumers contains DeckOfferCard and compositionContract. gauntlet-match groups shared duel rules with existing match presentation code. No babylon-shared or WebGL-shader chunk was requested.

limitations: Local QA timings are not production latency or real-user Web Vitals.
CPU throttling simulates a slower CPU; its slower loading and typing results are retained above.
Existing public-content and account JSON also affect initial startup. The Admin JavaScript budget does not measure API response sizes.
Three host-speed samples characterize this fixture and machine only; no statistical latency guarantee is implied.
